title: The dynamics of protein-RNA interfaces using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations
author: Sabei, Afra
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Identify protein‑RNA complexes
steps.instruction: Gather the nine protein‑RNA complexes to be simulated: 1ASY (aspartyl‑tRNA synthase/tRNA), 1JBS (ribotoxin restrictocin/SRD RNA), 1MMS (ribosomal protein L11/23S), 1OOA (NF‑kappaB p105 subunit/RNA aptamer), 1RKJ (nucleolin/pre‑rRNA), 2R8S (FAB/P4‑P6 RNA ribozyme domain), 2VPL (50S ribosomal protein/mRNA), 2ZM5 (tRNA delta(2)‑isopentenylpyrophosphate transferase/tRNA), 3IEV (GTP‑binding protein era/3' end of 16S rRNA).

steps.title: Create folder hierarchy
steps.instruction: For each complex, create a main directory named with the complex identifier. Inside this directory create three subfolders named exactly: “complex”, “protein”, and “rna”.

steps.title: Place MD simulation files
steps.instruction: In each of the three subfolders copy the dry all‑atom molecular dynamics trajectory files, which are named md_(times of simulations).xtc (the * part indicates the simulation time), and the corresponding starting structure file named start.gro.
